releaseNotes.headline: See your AI work in one place

highlights.detail: A Memory tile shows AI tools’ share of this Mac’s memory and their branch and worktree counts. Hover the tile or a tool row for work details, processes, and ports.
highlights.title: Memory and work in the rail

highlights.detail: The new Branches window groups running work, items that need a look, and candidates to clear. Open a card to review commits, changed-file names, and disk usage before choosing what to remove.
highlights.title: Review local branches and worktrees

highlights.detail: Review individual items before clearing them. Recent work starts unchecked, each item is checked again before removal, and Undo can restore branches and folders.
highlights.title: Clear with review and Undo

highlights.detail: Reused hover details and reset scheduling prevent accumulated memory and timers, while animations and Claude cache reads do less idle work. Rail corners are cleaner.
highlights.title: A lighter, steadier rail

releaseNotes.summary: The rail now shows AI tools’ memory share and active work. Review local branches and worktrees in the new Branches window, alongside fixes for rail memory growth and idle CPU use.
